skills.name: loova-product-photoshoot
skills.description: Create studio, lifestyle, or campaign images for a specific product using Loova. Use for new product photography from product references or a concept brief; use an editing or listing workflow for local retouching or a product listing set.
inputs: Product image or a concept description
Intended use and optional aspect ratio or output count
outputs: Product images or a requested photography plan
skills.example: Create a lifestyle photo of this bottle on a lakeside camping table at golden hour. Keep the product and logo unchanged.

skills.name: loova-product-listing-images
skills.description: Create coordinated product listing images with Loova, including hero, feature, detail, lifestyle, and specification images. Use for ecommerce image sets with consistent SKU facts; not for video or a small edit to a single image.
skills.scenario: Ecommerce listings and product detail pages
inputs: Product images, SKU details, and verified product facts
Listing destination and requested modules or count
outputs: An image order and any unverified facts
skills.example: Create a main image, two feature images, and one specification image for this speaker using the attached product facts.

skills.name: loova-ai-image-editor
skills.description: Edit a supplied image with Loova, changing specified objects, backgrounds, details, or visual style while preserving the agreed subject and composition. Use for image edits; not for creating an unrelated image or only resizing a layout.
skills.scenario: Image retouching, background replacement, and restyling
outputs: An edited image and a concise change summary
skills.example: Give this bottle photo a warm beige studio background. Keep the bottle, logo, and composition unchanged.

skills.name: loova-thumbnail-cover-maker
skills.description: Create or revise video thumbnails and social covers with Loova, using a clear subject, accurate copy, and small-screen readability. Use for cover images or cover concepts; not for generating the video itself.
inputs: Placement, exact copy, and optional identity or brand references
outputs: Requested cover images or cover concepts
skills.example: Make a bold cover for my sneaker video. Use this shoe and the headline "YOUR NEXT MOVE".

skills.name: loova-ad-resizer
skills.description: Adapt an existing product or ad image to requested dimensions and aspect ratios with Loova-compatible editing or deterministic resizing. Preserve product proportions, copy, and required content through containment, cropping, extension, or reflow.
skills.scenario: Ad placement and multichannel creative adaptation
inputs: Target dimensions or ratios and protected content
skills.example: Adapt this square ad to 1080 x 1920 and 1920 x 1080. Preserve the full product, logo, and required copy.

skills.name: loova-viral-video-clone
skills.description: Adapt a reference video into a new product video with Loova, preserving the requested pacing and shot structure while using the user's product. Use for reference-led ad recreation; not for replacing only a person in the original footage.
skills.scenario: Reference-led product ads and campaign adaptation
outputs: A requested adaptation plan or completed video
skills.example: Make a version of this ad for my sneaker. Follow the reference pacing and shot structure, and use my product image.

skills.name: loova-product-video-maker
skills.description: Turn product images into showcase videos with Loova, coordinating camera motion, product motion, and shot continuity. Use for image-to-product-video work or storyboards; not for presenter ads, reference-ad recreation, or character motion transfer.
inputs: Showcase goal and optional duration, format, and audio requirements
outputs: A requested showcase video or shot plan
skills.example: Turn this sneaker photo into a cinematic product video, starting with detail close-ups and ending with a full reveal.

skills.name: loova-ugc-ad-creator
skills.description: Create presenter-led product ads with Loova, coordinating a natural script, product demonstration, speech, and supporting shots. Use for UGC-style ads and their scripts; not for a silent product-only showcase or identity replacement.
skills.scenario: Presenter ads, product explanations, and demonstrations
inputs: Product facts, audience, and supported claims
Language, duration, script, and CTA requirements
outputs: A requested script, shot plan, or finished UGC-style ad
skills.example: Create a UGC-style sunscreen ad with a woman presenting the product by the sea. Use only the supplied product claims.

skills.name: loova-character-swap
skills.description: Replace a specified person or character in source footage using Loova video editing, retaining the agreed scene, motion, camera, timing, and audio. Use for identity replacement in an existing video; not for performing reference motion in a new scene.
outputs: A replacement video and any preservation differences
skills.example: Replace only the person on the left with my reference character. Keep the original scene, movement, and music.

skills.name: loova-mimic-motion
skills.description: Make a target character perform movement from a reference video with Loova, separating identity, body motion, camera, and environment. Use for reference-motion transfer or motion plans; use source-video identity editing when the original scene must remain unchanged.
inputs: Target scene and optional timing requirements
outputs: A requested motion video or motion beat plan
skills.example: Make my robot perform the wave and turn from this reference video in a white studio, with the full body visible.
